title: ANDREAS Registry (Assessment of Novel Drug-coated Balloon Revascularization: Effectiveness, Angiographic Outcomes, and Safety)
official: ANDREAS Registry (Assessment of Novel Drug-coated Balloon Revascularization: Effectiveness, Angiographic Outcomes, and Safety)
summary: The primary objective of this protocol is to develop a comprehensive, multicenter international prospective registry to capture long-term clinical outcomes for adult patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) with drug-coated balloons (DCB) for de novo coronary artery disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All adult patients (≥ 18 years of age) undergoing PCI for de novo CAD using DCB

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under the age of 18; PCI procedures without the utilization of DCB; PCI procedures for non de novo lesions
